deals.date_text: Committed 19 April 2017, conditional on the 1 June 2017 members' vote on the spin-off and on promotion
deals.evidence: gegen eine sofortige Zahlung von 41,5 Millionen Euro
deals.headline: Daimler commits EUR 41.5m for 11.75% of VfB Stuttgart 1893 AG
deals.summary: Daimler's board committed to become anchor investor in the newly spun-off VfB Stuttgart 1893 AG: EUR 41.5m for 11.75% if VfB were promoted (the club said this implied an enterprise value of more than EUR 350m), or 5% for EUR 10.5m if it stayed in the 2. Bundesliga. The stake has since been diluted to 10.4% by later investors.

deals.evidence: Jako übernimmt 1,16 Prozent der Anteile an der ausgegliederten Profiabteilung der Schwaben und zahlt dafür rund vier Millionen Euro
deals.headline: Kit supplier Jako buys 1.16% of VfB Stuttgart AG
deals.summary: Jako extended its kit deal to 2029 and took 1.16% of VfB Stuttgart 1893 AG, paying 'around four million euros' according to then-CEO Thomas Hitzlsperger (dpa); the stake is now 1.0% after Porsche's entry.

deals.date_text: Announced June 2023; first tranche closed 26 January 2024
deals.evidence: hat die Porsche AG in einem ersten Schritt 5,49 Prozent der Anteile an der VfB Stuttgart 1893 AG erworben
deals.headline: Porsche closes first 5.49% tranche of VfB Stuttgart AG
deals.investor: Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG
deals.summary: After DFL and Federal Cartel Office approval, Porsche AG acquired 5.49% of VfB Stuttgart 1893 AG and two supervisory board seats, alongside a sponsorship package. No official price was given; dpa reported VfB would receive around EUR 40m in total for both tranches.

deals.evidence: Die zweite Tranche in Höhe von 5,20 Prozent ist für Juni 2024 geplant.
deals.headline: Porsche's second 5.20% tranche takes it to 10.4% of VfB Stuttgart AG
deals.investor: Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG
deals.summary: The second tranche of 5.20% was scheduled for June 2024, after which the e.V. would hold 78.2%, Mercedes-Benz and Porsche 10.4% each and Jako 1.0%. Porsche's own release puts its post-tranche holding at 10.41%.

stadium_owner.detail: Owned by Stadion NeckarPark GmbH & Co. KG (operator: VfB Stuttgart Arena Betriebs GmbH). The City of Stuttgart is its sole limited partner and owns its general partner; VfB (since 2017 the VfB Stuttgart 1893 AG) is an atypical silent partner with a EUR 27m contribution under a 16 July 2008 agreement, the internal split being 60% city / 40% VfB AG (city council paper GRDrs 565/2020).

name: VfB Stuttgart 1893
notes: Revenue is the AG's 'Gesamtertrag' (total income) for calendar-year 2025 as the CEO reported it at the July 2026 members' meeting; the club does not say whether it includes transfer income, and it gives no matchday/media/commercial split for 2025. The same release states a 2025 profit after tax of EUR 22.5m and equity of EUR 83.4m at 31 Dec 2025 (no pre-tax or operating figure stated). The DFL's published club figures for the same year (group accounts, T€) give personnel expense 163,850 (recorded as wages) and a result after tax of 22,770; the DFL shows 'Rohergebnis' (361,164), not revenue, so the club's own Gesamtertrag is used for revenue. Deloitte's Money League 2026 ranks VfB 18th for 2024/25 but its page text gives only matchday revenue (EUR 70m); the earlier record's EUR 296.3m total came from an aggregator and was not re-found on a Deloitte page, so it is dropped. No Forbes/Sportico valuation exists; the only stated valuation is the club's 2017 remark that Daimler's terms implied an enterprise value of 'more than EUR 350m'. No official price for Porsche's stake: dpa reported 'around EUR 40m' for both tranches; the 2025 zvw interview has the CEO saying 3.9% remain to be sold. The second Porsche tranche is cited from the club's January 2024 statement that it was planned for June 2024 (zvw later describes Porsche as holding about ten percent). Stadium ownership split is from the City of Stuttgart's 2020 council paper on the stadium company's 2019 accounts. Attendance is the 2024/25 Bundesliga average; the club says 2025/26 set a record but the figure was not found. No social follower counts found on a citable dated page.

ownership_summary: The professional football operation is VfB Stuttgart 1893 AG (spun off in 2017), majority-owned by the members' club VfB Stuttgart 1893 e.V. with 78.2%. Mercedes-Benz Group AG (entered 2017 as Daimler AG) and Porsche AG (entered 2024 in two tranches) hold 10.4% each and kit supplier Jako AG holds 1.0%; the club has said it intends to sell the remaining 3.9% permitted by its statutes through a further capital increase.
